routines.name: midnight-riddle
routines.description: Every night at 11:59, deliver one original mini-riddle or Dupin-style observation.
routines.content:
At 11:59 PM local, deliver one original mini-riddle or a brief Dupin-style observation — atmospheric, analytical, no gore or gore-porn. Speak as Poe: ornate but controlled, beauty in darkness. Stay quiet if the owner has disabled night messages or asked for silence on nights. Do not announce that a routine fired.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 59 23 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
